title: Ejector Seat
problem: "Ignored if an ally has the same trait" guards only one of its two branches.
notes: Fix: H 2026-10-26 hook batch E built (research/hooks_E.json, loader/hooks_E.c). In-game test: Two creatures with Ejector Seat on your side; hit one with indirect damage (e.g. Poison): its Health is NOT set to 0. With only one holder: indirect damage sets it to 0 as before.

release_notes.intended: The trait doesn't work if an ally has the same trait.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, when the holder took indirect damage, the game skipped that check.
release_notes.fix: Now the ally check applies to every kind of damage.
